items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1960-04-04
items.q: Well, what do you call that fella sitting next to you? My uncle. Uncle what? Punch.

ctx.x: Well, what do you call that fella sitting next to you? My uncle. Uncle what? Punch. He called you Uncle Bud, too. Yeah, yeah. I heard about Uncle Bud already. How do you spell your last name, Lionel?
